title: Network Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
LBS Skill Centre is a professional training and development organization focused on building industry-relevant technical skills. The centre offers practical, hands-on programs designed to prepare learners for real-world roles in IT and networking. Located in Kothamangalam, LBS Skill Centre collaborates with experienced practitioners and educators to deliver up-to-date, job-ready training. The environment emphasizes continuous learning, professional growth, and the application of best practices in technology and engineering.
  
**Role Description**
The Network Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Kothamangalam. This role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining wired and wireless network infrastructure to support the centre’s operations and training activities. Day-to-day responsibilities include monitoring network performance, diagnosing and resolving technical issues, managing network devices and configurations, and ensuring secure, reliable connectivity for staff, students, and training environments. The Network Engineer will also implement and maintain network security measures, document network architecture and procedures, and collaborate with trainers and administrative teams to support lab setups and technology initiatives.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Network Engineering and Network Design to plan, implement, and optimize network infrastructures.
* Candidates should possess solid Network Administration skills, including configuration, monitoring, and maintenance of routers, switches, firewalls, and access points.
* Candidates should possess expertise in Troubleshooting to identify, analyze, and resolve network performance and connectivity issues efficiently.
* Candidates should possess skills in Network Security to implement and manage secure access controls, firewalls, VPNs, and security policies.
* Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent are highly beneficial.
* Experience with TCP/IP, VLANs, routing protocols, and wireless networking technologies is preferred.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively and support non-technical stakeholders.
* Diploma or degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in networking.

title: IoT Architect
description:
**Kerala Vision Broadband Limited** 
 is seeking an experienced
 **IoT Architect** 
 to join our
 **Solution Engineering – IoT \& Digital Solutions Team** 
 and drive next\-generation IoT, Smart City, and Digital Transformation initiatives.
 



 📍
 **Location:** 
 Ernakulam / Thrissur
 



 💼
 **Experience:** 
 8–14 Years
 



 🏢
 **Department:** 
 Solution Engineering – IoT \& Digital Solutions Practice
   




 ◆ Role Overview
 
 The IoT Architect is a broad\-spectrum technology strategist responsible for designing end\-to\-end IoT solutions across devices, connectivity, edge computing, cloud platforms, and application layers. As Kerala Vision expands its Managed Services \& System Integration (MSI) business, IoT is a key growth area covering Smart Cities, Industrial IoT, Smart Metering, Fleet Management, Healthcare IoT, and Building Management Systems.
 


 ◆ Key Responsibilities
 * Design end\-to\-end IoT architectures covering device, connectivity, edge, cloud, and application layers.
* Architect solutions using AWS IoT, Azure IoT, Google Cloud IoT, ThingsBoard, and similar platforms.
* Develop Smart City and Industrial IoT (IIoT) solutions for enterprise and government customers.
* Design IoT security frameworks including device identity, OTA updates, and secure communications.
* Support technical pre\-sales activities including customer presentations, solution proposals, BoQs, and RFP/RFI responses.
* Leverage ISP connectivity assets such as NB\-IoT, LTE\-M, eSIM, and APN services to build innovative solutions.
* Engage with OEMs, technology partners, and industry stakeholders to deliver best\-in\-class IoT solutions.



  




 ◆ Educational Qualification
 
 🎓 B.E./B.Tech in Electronics \& Communication, Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or related disciplines.
 



 🎓 MCA / M.Sc. (IT/Networks) with relevant industry experience may also be considered.
 



 🎓 M.Tech / MBA (Technology Management) will be an added advantage.
 



  




 ◆ What We're Looking For
 
 ✔ Proven experience in designing and delivering end\-to\-end IoT solutions.
 



 ✔ Strong understanding of IoT connectivity, cloud platforms, edge computing, analytics, and security.
 



 ✔ Excellent customer\-facing, pre\-sales, and solution presentation skills.
 



 ✔ Ability to translate complex technical architectures into business\-focused solutions.
 



  





 📩 Interested candidates may send their updated resume to:
 



 careers@keralavisionisp.com
